issues.description: play.ts changed from public import to relative source path and contains debug console.log scaffolding
issues.detail: play.ts now imports from './packages/zod/src/index.js' and runs console.log debug code. This is a scratch file that should not be committed in this state — it breaks any user/contributor running play.ts from a fresh checkout and pollutes the diff. Revert or remove before merge.

issues.description: override callback now fires on parent (isParent) schemas, doubling override invocations
issues.detail: The `if (!seen.isParent)` guard was removed from finalize(), and the test assertion changed from 6 to 12 invocations. This is a behavior change for users who rely on `override` not running on intermediate parent nodes (the test name 'do not run on references' explicitly documented that contract). Needs explicit changelog/migration note or reconsideration.

issues.description: Repeated JSON.stringify-based deep equality on every property is O(n*size) and can be expensive on large schemas
issues.detail: Two loops use `JSON.stringify(schema[key]) === JSON.stringify(refSeen.def![key])` to dedupe properties against the parent definition. For schemas with large nested values (enums, big object shapes) this re-serializes on every key compare during finalize, which can blow up cost. Consider a cheaper structural check or memoize the stringified parent def.

issues.description: Cast `(zodSchema as any)._zod.parent === ref` bypasses the Seen.parent field just introduced
issues.detail: finalize() reads `(zodSchema as any)._zod.parent` directly to decide `isParentRef`, instead of using the newly added `seen.parent` it just set during process(). This duplicates source-of-truth and the `as any` cast hides type errors. Use `seen.parent === ref` for consistency and type safety.

issues.description: Mini schemas.ts now passes `{ parent: true }`, changing inheritance semantics for ZodMini users
issues.detail: The previously commented-out `{ parent: true }` is now active in mini's check() clone path. This is a real behavior change for the Mini distribution — every refinement chain now establishes parent tracking, affecting JSON Schema output and the override callback frequency. Should be called out in the changelog and validated against mini's own tests.

issues.description: z.file() anyOf snapshot hoists shared props to root — verify draft-04/draft-07/openapi-3.0 still validate
issues.detail: The new fileProcessor output places `type`, `contentEncoding`, `format`, `maxLength`, `minLength` at the root and leaves only `contentMediaType` inside each anyOf branch. Semantically equivalent under draft 2020-12, but worth confirming this shape works under older targets where anyOf + sibling keywords interact differently with $ref/allOf paths.

review.summary: The core change to track `parent` separately from processor-set `ref` and propagate `$ref` for wrapper schemas with ids is a reasonable fix and the new test demonstrates the intended behavior. However, the diff ships a debugging `play.ts` that imports from a relative source path, removes the `isParent` guard on the override callback (changing public behavior — see the 6→12 assertion), and activates `{ parent: true }` in Mini, all of which deserve explicit changelog notes. The dedupe logic relies on repeated `JSON.stringify` comparisons which is a latent performance concern, and an `as any` cast bypasses the new `seen.parent` field instead of using it.
